body:
WHAT
Reasoning stays inside the output total and is shown as its part of it.
- Protocol (optional, mirrored in tui/src/protocol.ts): Usage.reasoningTokens — the part of outputTokens that was reasoning — and Usage.reasoningEstimated; context_update.reasoningTokens (the live estimate). addUsage sums reasoningTokens only once some response reported one (a total that never had reasoning keeps exactly four classes) and keeps reasoningEstimated sticky. reasoningPart(usage) prints "reasoning 135k" / "reasoning ~135k".
- The OpenAI-compatible adapter reads completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens (OpenAI's contract: a part of completion_tokens), clamped to completion_tokens. No Responses-API provider exists here. The Anthropic adapter reads usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens from the final message_delta (the part of output_tokens that was thinking), clamped to output_tokens; absent, it stays unreported. A reported 0 (or less) is not a count: the stream's own estimate stands in.
- The session: when a response streamed reasoning and the provider reported no count, its reasoning part is counted from the streamed reasoning characters (estimateTokens), capped by its output, and marked reasoningEstimated. The live context_update carries the reasoning part too (banked + this call's reasoning so far).
- /session prints each model's output as "… output (reasoning ~135k), …". The desktop live strip and a tiled pane's strip read "↑ 200k out · ~135k reasoning", the inspector's Usage line adds "135k reasoning"; the TUI composer and turn footer read "out 200k · reasoning 135k".

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, finding U-10 (the owner's question): MAGENTRA counts reasoning as output, and that is correct — Anthropic and OpenAI both bill reasoning as output — but it showed one number ("200k out"), so the user could not see that about two thirds of it was reasoning.

WHERE
engine/protocol/src/types.ts (Usage, context_update), engine/protocol/src/tokens.ts (addUsage, reasoningPart), engine/providers/src/openai-compat.ts, engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts (the estimate before recordResponse; emitLiveTokens), engine/core/src/runtime/sessionStats.ts (deliberationReasoningTokens, fromSnapshot, format). app/renderer/modules/tokens.js (reasoningText, outputTokensText), session.js/tabs.js (per-tab state), views.js, workbench.js, landing.js. tui/src/format.ts, useEngine.ts, Composer.tsx, TranscriptLine.tsx.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (pure) addUsage adds reasoning parts and keeps the estimated mark; four-class usages sum to exactly four keys; reasoningPart prints the exact and the estimated form and nothing for none.
2. (net) The adapter reads completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, clamps it to completion_tokens, and adds no key when the server sends none.
3. (fs) A real engine turn whose response streams 7,000 characters of reasoning with an unreported count ends with usage.reasoningTokens = 2,000 (7,000 / 3.5) and reasoningEstimated; a reported count is kept exactly and not marked; /session shows "(reasoning ~2.0k)"; the live context_update carried a reasoning part.
4. (ui) The desktop strip shows "· ~N reasoning" from a context_update, and the inspector the exact figure after a turn_finished that reported one.
5. (llm) On the configured connection, one turn's usage keeps its reasoning inside its output, and the test records whether this provider reports the count (Fireworks, 2026-09-23).

ADDED 2026-09-24 (audit follow-up):
- (net) The Anthropic adapter reads output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, clamped; the OpenAI-compatible one leaves out a reported 0 or a negative value.
- (fs) A reported 0 beside streamed reasoning is estimated from the stream.
